title: gsmarena device slug index (split with box-reasoning)
why: The OTHER binding constraint. 22,173 of 34,261 rows have no chipset, so the chipset lane can only see 84 devices. Chipset comes from gsmarena spec pages, and reaching them needs a device->slug index. gsmarena answers on BOTH boxes, so this is not about unblocking — it is about not pulling ~30 brand pages plus hundreds of device pages from a single address. You take the second half.
control: the Samsung brand page is fetched first and asserted to contain device links; if it does not, the run reports blocked rather than an empty index
expect: Do NOT touch res.php3?sSearch= — that endpoint is Turnstile-gated and returns 200 with a 2,748B challenge page. Brand and device pages are fine. 2s between requests, and stop and report if you see a 429.
